notes.title: WH40K SKULLS 2021 BUILD! 2 New flyable planes + skull patterns for all planes
notes.content:
For the Skulls event this year, Dakka Squadron is bringing you 
- 2 new flyable planes (looted Arvus Lighter and looted Doom Scythe)
- Cool skull patterns that can be applied to all planes
- a 40% discount for the Skulls event!

DAKKA DAKKA DAKKA!!!

notes.title: 3 Lives Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39279010/291d7d3f060a1ae97e847c82374d767fbaf363fc.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] We have added in the option to play with 3 lives in missions.  That means you can be shot down twice in a mission and still have a chance to pick back up where you left off. You will also have the option to play with only 1 life and gain an increased teef reward for doing so.

[*] We have adjusted how the objectives work in the Mek Shop Don't Stop and Scrap Heist missions so the objectives will advance if enemies are destroyed.  This will create a more player-directed experience, and reduce player fatigue of long defensive sections.  

[*] We have added in an auto-level button so if you get your plane in a cockeyed position you can level back out.

[*] We have various bug fixes, a bit of MP weapon balance, HUD improvements, addressed some achievement wonkiness, and MP transition stability.
[/list]

WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGH!
